license_required.quote: It is unlawful for a person to engage in the practice of accountancy as regulated by this board without holding a valid license or registration or without qualifying for a practice privilege pursuant to Section 40-2-245.

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the South Carolina Board of Accountancy.

age_minimum.quote: be at least eighteen years of age

moral_character_required.quote: evidence of good moral character, which includes a lack of a history of

degree_required.quote: have a baccalaureate degree or higher from an accredited institution

accrediting_body.value: accreditation body approved by the United States Department of Education
accrediting_body.quote: The board shall accept transcripts from a college or university holding an accreditation from an accreditation body approved by the United States Department of Education

required.quote: an applicant shall attain the following experience

duration.value: one or two years depending on education level
duration.quote: applicants who have completed a baccalaureate degree must complete two years of relevant professional experience; applicants who have completed a post-baccalaureate degree, or a baccalaureate degree with at least one hundred fifty total semester credit hours, must complete one year of relevant experience

kind.quote: experience means providing any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax, or consulting skills

exams.name: Uniform CPA Examination
exams.notes: All sections must be passed within a rolling 36-month period
exams.quote: To meet the exam requirement, a candidate must pass all sections of the Uniform CPA Examination.

exams.name: Professional Ethics Examination
exams.notes: Board-approved ethics exam required for initial licensure
exams.quote: evidence of a passing score on an examination in professional ethics as approved by the board

interval_years.quote: Registration must be initially issued and renewed annually.

required.quote: A licensee shall document forty hours of continuing professional education that is acceptable to the board, completed during the immediately preceding calendar year.

hours_per_period.quote: A licensee shall document forty hours of continuing professional education that is acceptable to the board, completed during the immediately preceding calendar year.

period_years.quote: completed during the immediately preceding calendar year

topical_requirements.quote: An annual ethics requirement must be met and included in the documented hours of continuing professional education. No less than two hours of the annual forty hours of continuing professional education must relate to ethics.

available.quote: A CPA licensed in another jurisdiction who moves his principal place of business to this State may obtain a license through reciprocity.

requirements.value: Must have passed the Uniform CPA Examination, hold an active certificate/license/permit from another state or recognized foreign authority, be legally authorized to practice in that jurisdiction, and certify compliance with CPE requirements in that jurisdiction.
requirements.quote: has successfully passed the Uniform CPA Examination; holds an active certificate, license, or permit issued pursuant to the laws of any state or territory of the United States, the District of Columbia, or any foreign licensing authority that is recognized by the International Qualifications Appraisal Board and subject to Mutual Recognition Agreements; is legally authorized to practice in the jurisdiction where his existing certificate, license, or permit is held; and certifies that he is in compliance with the continuing professional education requirements in the jurisdiction where his existing certificate, license, or permit is held.

regulatory_model.quote: It is unlawful for a person to engage in the practice of accountancy as regulated by this board without holding a valid license or registration or without qualifying for a practice privilege pursuant to Section 40-2-245.

title_protection.quote: Only a person holding a valid license as a certified public accountant or qualifying for a practice privilege under Section 40-2-245 shall use or assume the title "Certified Public Accountant" or the abbreviation "CPA"

scope_protection.quote: Only licensed certified public accountants or public accountants or individuals qualifying for a practice privilege pursuant to Section 40-2-245 may issue a report on financial statements of a person, firm, organization, or governmental unit or offer to render or render any attest or compilation service

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or crime with an element of dishonesty or fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conviction of a felony that has an element of dishonesty or fraud or any other crime that has an element of dishonesty or fraud, under the laws of the United States, of this State, or of any other state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conduct reflecting adversely upon the licensee's fitness to perform services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: conduct reflecting adversely upon the licensee's fitness to perform services as a licensee

disciplinary_grounds.description: Use of false, fraudulent, or forged statement or document in obtaining licensure
disciplinary_grounds.quote: use of a false, fraudulent, or forged statement or document or committal of a fraudulent, deceitful, or dishonest act or omission of a material fact in obtaining licensure pursuant to this chapter

disciplinary_grounds.description: Intentional use of a false or fraudulent statement in a document connected with professional practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: intentional use of a false or fraudulent statement in a document connected with the practice of the individual's profession or occupation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining fees or assistance in obtaining fees under fraudulent circumstances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: obtaining fees or assistance in obtaining fees under fraudulent circumstances

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to comply with established professional standards including federal or state law
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to comply with established professional standards, including standards set by federal or state law or regulation

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the board's code of professional ethics or AICPA Professional Standards
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violation of the code of professional ethics adopted by the board or of the AICPA Professional Standards: Code of Professional Conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to respond to board requests for information or cooperate in investigations
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to respond to requests for information or to cooperate in investigations on behalf of the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in or aiding unlicensed practice of accounting
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engagement or aid of another, intentionally or knowingly, directly or indirectly, in unlicensed practice of accounting

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to disclose or disclaim the appropriate license status of an unlicensed person associated with financial statements
disciplinary_grounds.quote: failure to disclose or disclaim the appropriate license status of a person or entity not holding a license but associated with financial statements

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advertising or solicitation that is false, misleading, deceptive, or promotes unsupported claims
disciplinary_grounds.quote: engagement in advertising or other forms of solicitation or use of a firm name in a manner that is false, misleading, deceptive, or tending to promote unsupported claims

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, reprimand, or other discipline of the right to practice in another state or by a federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the revocation, suspension, reprimand, or other discipline of the right to practice by the licensee in any other state or by a federal agency for a cause other than the failure to pay an annual registration fee.

definition_quote.value: issuing a report on financial statements of a person, firm, organization, or governmental unit or offering to render or rendering any attest or compilation service; or using or assuming the title 'Certified Public Accountant' or the abbreviation 'CPA'
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of accounting" means: (a) issuing a report on financial statements of a person, firm, organization, or governmental unit or offering to render or rendering any attest or compilation service... or (b) using or assuming the title "Certified Public Accountant" or the abbreviation "CPA"

value: examination, review, or agreed upon procedures (SSAE)
methods_authorized.quote: any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); any review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); any examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); any engagement to be performed in accordance with Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) Auditing Standards; or any examination, review, or agreed upon procedure to be performed in accordance with the SSAE

value: audit or other engagement under SAS
review of financial statements under SSARS
examination of prospective financial information under SSAE
examination, review, or agreed upon procedure under SSAE (other than prospective financial information examination)
attest_services_types.quote: any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); any review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); any examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with the Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); any engagement to be performed in accordance with Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB) Auditing Standards; or any examination, review, or agreed upon procedure to be performed in accordance with the SSAE

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Compilation" means providing a service of any compilation engagement to be performed in accordance with SSARS.

education_semester_hours_required.quote: applicants who have completed a post-baccalaureate degree, or a baccalaureate degree with at least one hundred fifty total semester credit hours, must also satisfy the experience requirements in Section 40-2-35(G)(1)(b), which requires one year of relevant experience.

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: the applicant must have on record with the board official transcripts demonstrating successful completion of either: (a) at least one hundred twenty semester hours of credit; or (b) a conferred baccalaureate degree.

ethics_exam_required.quote: evidence of a passing score on an examination in professional ethics as approved by the board and an affidavit by the candidate acknowledging that he or she has read the statute and regulations governing the practice of accountancy in South Carolina

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: No notice, fee, or other submission is required for the individual to practice pursuant to these privileges.

value: consents to personal and subject matter jurisdiction of the board and its disciplinary authority
agrees to comply with the regulations and provisions of this section
agrees to cease offering or rendering professional services in this State if their license, permit, or certificate from principal jurisdiction is no longer valid
consents to service of an administrative notice of hearing at the board in the individual's principal jurisdiction
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: consents to the personal and subject matter jurisdiction of the board and its disciplinary authority; agrees to comply with the regulations and provisions of this section; agrees to cease offering or rendering professional services in this State, individually or on behalf of a firm, if their license, permit, or certificate from his principal jurisdiction is no longer valid; consents to service of an administrative notice of hearing at the board in the individual's principal jurisdiction

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: performs these services through an individual with practice privileges under Section 40-2-245

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: A simple majority of the firm ownership in terms of financial interests and voting rights of all partners, officers, shareholders, members, or managers must belong to certified public accountants currently licensed in some state.

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: Although firm ownership may include non-CPA owners, the firm and its owners must comply with regulations promulgated by the board.

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: As a condition of renewal of registration, an applicant who engages in attest or compilation services, or both, must provide evidence of satisfactory completion of peer review no more frequently than once every three years.

peer_review_max_frequency_years.quote: must provide evidence of satisfactory completion of peer review no more frequently than once every three years

peer_review_records_privileged.quote: require peer reviews to be conducted and that work and documents be maintained in a manner designed to preserve confidentiality of documents furnished or generated in the course of the review.

inactive_license_status_available.quote: establish criteria for issuing, renewing, and reactivating authorizations for qualified applicants to practice, including issuing active or permanent, temporary, limited, and inactive licenses or other categories as may be created

retired_license_status_available.quote: A licensee may apply to the board for permission to place the word "Retired" adjacent to his "Certified Public Accountant" title

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: Firms that do not have an office in this State may engage in the practice of accounting, without obtaining a registration pursuant to Section 40-2-40, as specified in this subsection.

office_supervision_by_licensed_cpa_requi.quote: there must be a designated resident manager in charge of each office in this State who must be a certified public accountant licensed in this State.

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: This review must include a verification that individuals in the firm, who are responsible for supervising attest or compilation services, or both, and who sign or authorize someone to sign the accountant's report on the financial statements on behalf of the firm, meet the competency requirements set out in the professional standards for these services

client_confidentiality_privilege.quote: a licensee under this chapter must not voluntarily disclose information communicated by the client relating to and in connection with services rendered. This information is confidential.

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: CPA-prepared records and CPA work papers created by a licensee or on behalf of a registrant, incident to, or in the course of, rendering services to a client, except the reports submitted by the licensee to the client and except for CPA work product, are and remain the property of the licensee in the absence of an expressed agreement between the licensee and the client to the contrary.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: Transmittals using the following language must not be considered the unlicensed practice of accountancy: "I (we) have prepared the accompanying (financial statements) of (name of entity)...I (we) have not audited or reviewed the accompanying financial statements and accordingly do not express an opinion or any other form of assurance on them."

foreign_accountant_practice_exception.quote: This section does not apply to a person or firm holding a certification, designation, degree, or license granted in a foreign country entitling the holder to engage in the practice of public accountancy or its equivalent in that country; whose activities in this State are limited to the provision of professional services to persons or firms who are residents of, governments of, or business entities of the country in which the person holds the entitlement; who performs no attest or compilation services

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: A firm that falls out of compliance with the provisions of this section due to changes in firm ownership or personnel, after receiving or renewing a permit, shall take corrective action to bring the firm back into compliance as quickly as possible. The board may grant a reasonable period of time for a firm to take this corrective action.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: a firm with an office in this State performing attest services as defined in Section 40-2-20(2) or engaging in the practice of accounting

accounting_practitioner_tier.quote: In order to be eligible for licensing under this article as an accounting practitioner, an applicant may not hold another license granted under this chapter

cpa_emeritus_or_retired_status_available.quote: A licensee who is retired and does not perform or offer to perform for compensation one or more kinds of services involving the use of accounting or auditing skills...may apply to the board for permission to place the word "Emeritus" adjacent to the licensee's "Certified Public Accountant" title

ethics_cpe_hours_required.quote: No less than two hours of the annual forty hours of continuing professional education must relate to ethics.

client_records_return_obligation.quote: A licensee shall furnish to a client or former client, upon request and reasonable notice, the following documents with respect to the client or former client: (1) any client records
